name: Pizza Lunch Bot
short_desc: Weekly pizza polls and RSVPs in Telegram
author: EckPhi
description: A Telegram bot that polls your group for a pizza day, picks the winning slot, and collects RSVPs, with an optional Telegram Mini App.

form_fields.label: Telegram bot token
form_fields.hint: Create a bot with @BotFather and enter its token.

form_fields.label: Lunch time zone
form_fields.hint: IANA time zone used for the Monday cutoff and lunch time.

form_fields.label: Telegram Mini App short name
form_fields.pattern_error: Use 3 to 30 letters, digits, or underscores.
form_fields.hint: Enter the short name registered in BotFather. Leave blank to run in Telegram chat only.
